ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

3. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.

4. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

7. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

11. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

12. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   D. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.

13. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

14. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

15. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthing and Excess Current Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Inspection and Testing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
